items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...Eddie Henderson, Gary Bartz, Onaji, Buster [Williams], everybody. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Was I on that? ... [INTERVIEWER] It’s called Love from the Sun. Eddie Henderson, Gary Bartz, Carlos Garnett, Herbie, Onaji, Buster, Kenneth Nash. Dee Dee Bridgewater singing. Any recollection? [INTERV
